verdict.rationale: The only bulk-like evidence is the DNS API's 'replace' operation (docs-4, docs-19), which suggests swapping a domain's whole record set in one call. Other operations (registration, renewal, lock, forwarding) appear to be per-domain calls, and agents would have to loop over them via the API or gddy CLI. missing for 10: documented bulk/batch endpoints across many domains (e.g., bulk renew, bulk DNS edits, bulk lock changes), multi-item CLI commands, agent or MCP bulk workflows, and hands-on corroboration.
